class.name: ScenarioEventCondition
class.brief_description: Decides whether a [ScenarioEventServer] event runs and whether a launcher fires.
class.description: Decides whether an event runs its action's [method ScenarioEventAction._run] or [method ScenarioEventAction._run_else], and whether a launcher fires. Implement it in C++ by overriding [code]test()[/code], or in GDScript by overriding [method _test]. A condition that implements neither passes.

method.name: _test
method.description: Whether the condition passes for [param event], about to run, and its [param activator].
